newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Ethnic clash kills 37 at S.African platinum mine.
newsitem.headline: Ethnic clash kills 37 at S.African platinum mine.

text.p: At least 37 black South Africans have been killed in a weekend of ethnic clashes at or near a platinum mine northwest of Johannesburg, police said on Sunday.
A police spokesman said fighting between members of different tribes broke out on Saturday morning at a squatter camp called Freedom Park near the Wildebeesfontein mine in Rustenburg.
The clashes, between members of the Sotho and Xhosa tribes, spread to a hostel for migrant workers at the mine, owned by Impala Platinum Holdings.
"We recovered 17 bodies at the hostel and another two seriously injured men died in hospital. The rest were killed in the squatter camp," the spokesman said in a telephone interview.
He said no work at the mine had been scheduled for the weekend but mining had resumed at 9 p.m. (1900 GMT) on Sunday.
The situation at the mine was calm on Sunday night and army troops were helping to patrol the area and prevent further clashes.
